visual_units.body: Stepping into a new office feels cold. Learn how to warm up your professional relationships instantly.
visual_units.title: Break the Ice

visual_units.body:
To break the ice means to relieve tension or start a conversation when meeting people for the first time.
It helps overcome initial awkwardness in professional settings.
visual_units.title: What Does It Mean?

visual_units.body:
Use it during your first meeting with new coworkers.
Perfect for starting project kickoff sessions or workshops.
Great for networking events and team-building environments.
visual_units.title: When to Use It

visual_units.body:
I decided to break the ice at the morning meeting by asking about weekend activities.
To break the ice with my new desk mate, I introduced myself immediately.
visual_units.title: Real-Life Examples

visual_units.body:
A: Everyone looks so quiet and nervous before this big meeting.
B: Let me tell a quick joke to break the ice.
A: That really helped establish a comfortable working relationship!
visual_units.title: In Conversation

visual_units.body:
Mastering this idiom helps you confidently initiate conversations.
It reduces social awkwardness and builds better team dynamics.
visual_units.title: Key Takeaway
